claims.claim: Joints are connections between bones or other skeletal structures. Synovial joints have a cavity, articular cartilage and a capsule; supporting ligaments help constrain motion. Hinge-like joints such as the elbow primarily permit flexion and extension, while ball-and-socket joints such as the hip permit motion around several axes. Tendons transmit muscle force; ligaments generally connect bones. Joint shape, soft tissues and neuromuscular control influence available movement. Do not infer pathology from differences in range.
